luna_triage.identity_quote: Uchida   Akitoshi ,  Michael   Robert B. , and  Mori   Kazuo  ( 2020 ):  Scholastic achievement levels and conformity of junior high school students in the Asch experiment .  Psychology   11 :  1285 – 1299 .
luna_triage.location: Section 2.3 Individual differences (paragraph on intellectual competence)
luna_triage.omission_quote: Uchida et al. [ 31 ] studied 12 to 14 year-old high school students and assessed scholastic achievements by their school performance. They report that high achievers conformed less to the majority than low achievers.
luna_triage.reason: The paper discusses Uchida et al.'s scholastic achievement proxy result, then explicitly frames its own analysis as directly measuring intelligence because prior studies used indirect school-grade measures. Its intelligence test does not retest the reported scholastic-achievement comparison.

luna_triage.identity_quote: The effects of self-consciousness and self-esteem on conformity to a majority .  The Japanese Journal of Psychology   63 :  379 – 387 .  doi:  10.4992/jjpsy.63.379
luna_triage.omission_quote: The effect of self-esteem (or self-assertiveness, self-consciousness) on conformity was only investigated in a few studies so far. Kurosawa [ 11 ] found no effect on conformity when the decision of the minority subject was preceded by two confederates. In groups of four, confederates’ self-esteem had a negative effect on conformity.
luna_triage.reason: Kurosawa's cited effects concern the minority subject's decision following two confederates and the self-esteem of confederates in groups of four. The present H6 concerns the participant's self-esteem, so it does not retest either specified Kurosawa finding.

blind_target.evidence_quote: Claim for Review – The claim selected was that strongly tied customers who complain (vs. withhold feedback) after a service failure will increase their loyalty. In contrast, for weakly tied customers, complaining has no effect on loyalty.
blind_target.outcome_quote: Stage 2: H* was not supported as the interaction term on the overall ANOVA was not significant. In addition, the pattern of means in the strong ties group was not consistent but the pattern of means in the weak ties group was consistent.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: Both completed stages explicitly reject support for the focal interaction. A consistent weak-ties mean pattern is ancillary to the central failed test. The final report identifies the target by project shorthand, but supplies no reference entry.
